description: This file defines the AesDecryptingStream class, which implements a stream interface for decrypting data using AES cipher. It handles reading, seeking, and decrypting data blocks, and interacts with cipher methods and stream interfaces.

classes.name: AesDecryptingStream
classes.description: A class that provides a stream interface for decrypting AES-encrypted data, supporting reading and seeking within the decrypted stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decrypting stream with a ciphertext stream, key, and cipher method.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher name used for decryption.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the decrypted plaintext, or null if padding is required.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is not writable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the decrypted stream.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning; only supports seeking to start.

methods.name: decryptBlock
methods.description: Decrypts a block of ciphertext data of specified length.
